attribution.modificationNote: English opening-segment text only; bold markup removed, unsupported survival guarantee excluded. No assets, code, game dialogue, or later campaign steps imported.

steps.hint: Fight him in the corner opposite the entrance: afterwards walk straight past the blockade into town.

steps.text: Talk to Renly -> first Uncut Skill Gem
steps.hint: Cut your skill, then head straight out to Clearfell.

steps.text: Kill Beira of the Rotten Pack -> +10% cold resistance
steps.hint: Beira is in the middle of the zone. Pick up and use the Head of the Winter Wolf.

notes.text: Minimal: Just run to the exit to The Grelwood, Beira is optional.
Mysterious Campsite (checkpoint): guaranteed Uncut Skill Gem, e.g. for Frost Bomb (Exposure).
Skip the Mud Burrow: it only gives a Support Gem + gold from Renly.

steps.text: Grab the Waypoint at the Tree of Souls, then into The Red Vale
steps.hint: Follow the glowing roots to the Tree of Souls, then go upriver to the Red Vale.

notes.text: The 4 POIs form a diamond: Witch Hut, Grim Tangle entrance, Tree of Souls, Brambleghast. Once you know two, you know where the others are.
Follow the mushrooms to the Grim Tangle entrance, step in briefly and activate its Waypoint.
Witch Hut (optional): the cauldron gives a Medium Life + Mana Flask, even without the kill. Areagne, Forgotten Witch drops a Support Gem: Respawn at Checkpoint first so no monsters are nearby.
Skip Gerung, the Brambleghast: it only gives a level 2 Skill Gem.

excluded.reason: Numerical survival guarantee without sufficient character, attack, or variant evidence; do not import the threshold or imply safety.

openIssues: Source declares 0.5.5, not the 0.5.5e research target. Retrieval date is not patch verification.
Step sequence and notes do not establish all four direct area relationships or return-travel restrictions.
Mud Burrow has no standalone opening step; confirm acquisition and hand-in conditions without inferring them from a skip recommendation.
No independently verified Hardcore threat, trigger, damage, defenses, or safe threshold is supplied by this import.
Source must/skip tags are routing labels, not verified progression roles. Onward Grelwood instructions must become informational coverage boundaries, not additional actionable destinations.
